title: ALERT: HUGE LOSS SHORTING THE MARKET OR OPPORTUNITY!?
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: With Nasdaq and S&P at all-time highs, markets are 'incredibly overbought'; avoid leverage and welcome pullbacks as buying chances.
FedWatch shows a 19% chance of a rate hike at the FOMC in about three weeks; Fed minutes due the next day.

calls.condition: Would buy a pullback as a long-term investor
calls.reason: Indices at all-time highs and overbought with red flags; markets always pull back after a rip. He stays invested but unleveraged.
calls.quote: Markets are incredibly overbought. We see all the red flags presenting themselves as soon as sentiment begins to change, so does the market.

calls.reason: He has an open, just-added short but admits MSTR has been more bullish than bearish lately and plans to close it and take a break; still expects it to crash eventually.
calls.quote: We all know that eventually MSTR does a great job crashing, but that time will come when it present itself.

calls.condition: Overbought-reversal gap fill back to previous lows
calls.reason: Overbought reversal after a big push up; expects a sell-off to fill the gap back down, especially on the Toshiba supply news. He closed his short daily and did not hold it.
calls.quote: the goal was a big push up. And as it sold off that it could fill this gap right back down

notes: Host says 'happy Tuesday' -> 2026-10-06 (listing approx_date 10-07 is a day off). 'WWDC' is almost certainly a garbled WDC (Western Digital), given the Toshiba hard-drive supply news; the 465 'previous highs' level is assumed to be WDC's. The Marvell (MRVL) trade was a completed intraday short with no forward call; Dell's 'gap down potential' is mentioned in passing. Neither is recorded.
